name: ritmo-music
description: Sonora Music - Streaming de audio con PWA instalable, biblioteca, playlists, recomendaciones automaticas y version PRO.
author: Sonora Music

scripts.check:search: node scripts/check-search-fallback.mjs && node scripts/check-search-providers.mjs && node scripts/check-search-intent.mjs
scripts.apk:prepare: node scripts/write-capacitor-config.mjs && vite build && cap sync android
scripts.apk:build: node scripts/write-capacitor-config.mjs && vite build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: node scripts/write-capacitor-config.mjs && vite build && cap sync android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
